summary: The First Den has become a five-floor limestone keep above its wooded lake valley, while retaining the garden, gateway, furnishings/devices, and first-person home interaction systems around it. One live place combines authored scene placements with shared procedural terrain and garden/valley generators; scripts own player movement, the frozen fair-day ambience, doors, radio, and floor-to-floor waystones.
places: places/main - only live place; config owns spawn, gravity, terrain/sea, native atmosphere, and procedural valley decoration
places/main/cells/x0z0.scene - main authored home cell: castle-keep at (2,24,3), castle furnishings/decor and teleporter pads under home-root, plus garden, gateway, devices, and home effects
places/main/cells/objects.scene - supplemental authored home/foundation pieces and furnishings
places/main/cells/x0z-1.scene and neighboring authored cells - lake/valley framing and remote outcrops/trees; other cells contain the remaining authored landscape
roots: world.config.yaml - world entry wiring main place, player, camera, lighting, input/UI, networking and arrival behavior
templates/player.js#player - character root carrying movement, locomotion and home-feel behaviors
places/main/config.yaml - place runtime root for spawn, atmosphere, terrain, water/marks and procedural decoration
places/main/cells/x0z0.scene#castle-keep - composite round keep root; five 4.2m floors, inner spiral stair, outer stair to battlements
places/main/cells/x0z0.scene#home-root - authored placement parent for the keep's furniture/decor and retained home/garden/device objects
places/main/cells/x0z0.scene#home-weather-controller - runtime root synchronizing solar time, weather, ambience, life effects and practical lights
places/main/cells/x0z0.scene#home-portal - first-destination gateway root and its authored invitation/link state
shared: scripts/lib/data/castle.js - canonical KEEP dimensions, floor/window/door/stair geometry and keepPoint coordinates used by the castle generator
scripts/lib/data/home.js + scripts/gen/home-architecture-data.js - retained HOME coordinate/plan contracts shared by home placement and architecture generators
scripts/lib/data/home-portal.js + scripts/lib/portal-path.js + portal stonework data - shared gateway position, route, arch, prompt and chime contract
scripts/lib/data/home-day.js + home-weather.js + home-lamplight.js - solar, weather phase and practical-light settings consumed by home runtime scripts
scripts/lib/data/radio-library.js + radio-program.js + scripts/lib/radio-panel.js - station/song/report data, programme timing and UI contract for radio behavior/device
scripts/lib/data/player.yml + camera.yml + home-feel.js - movement/camera tuning and shared interaction, door and ambience parameters
notableExports: scripts/gen/castle-keep.js - exports openings, geometry and collider for the composite five-floor keep
scripts/lib/data/castle.js - exports KEEP and keepPoint for castle dimensions and polar placement
scripts/gen/castle-decor.js - exports geometry/collider for pads, carpets, paintings, plants, vases and chandeliers
scripts/gen/castle-furnish.js - exports geometry/collider for parameter-selected castle furniture
scripts/castle-pad.js - exports onTriggerEnter for player waystone travel
scripts/den-terrain.js - exports VALLEY, heightAt and materialAt for the lake-valley terrain
scripts/home-radio.js - exports stationAt, songsAt, songAt, beginMusic, fadeForReport and retireRadioBroadcast
scripts/gen/home-architecture-data.js - exports ARCH, ROOMS, WALLS, wall/plan/wing and roof helpers plus DOORS
ownership: places/main/cells/x0z0.scene - owns authored object ids, parents, transforms, seeds and state; castle-pad rows own each pad's dir, room label and destination/yaw
scripts/lib/data/castle.js - owns keep dimensions and feature coordinates; scripts/gen/castle-keep.js turns those into shell, floors, stairs, detail and collider
scripts/home-weather.js + scripts/lib/data/home-day.js/home-weather.js - own live atmosphere synchronization, place.state.weather, effects/ambience and the frozen hour/fair-phase definitions
scripts/home-radio.js - owns powered/station/song indices, programme phase/playhead, forecast interruption/resume and spatial audio state
scripts/home-door.js + scene door rows - own door open/closed state and safe leaf collision; door-label behaviors provide the prompt interaction
places/main/config.yaml + scripts/den-terrain.js - own terrain generator settings and derived terrain height/material bands
world.config.yaml - owns world identity, default place, networking, input bindings, player/camera wiring, lighting/UI and arrival hook
templates and generator scripts - own reusable object defaults, geometry/colliders and item-specific variants; scene instances provide placement-specific params
flows: moveX/moveZ and camera aim input -> scripts/player.js -> per-body move intent -> velocity/jump; character controller applies place gravity
move/look input -> scripts/humanoid-locomotion.js -> yaw and gait channels; parent attachment switches into sit/feet-IK behavior
player body target -> scripts/camera.js -> first-person camera eye position/view rotation and local-player hiding
interact input -> scripts/home-player-feel.js -> scripts/lib/home-interaction.js nearestInteractable -> press to best in-reach/look-aligned door, radio or usable object
door prompt ui:use -> home-door-label -> hinge state -> scripts/home-door.js toggles leaf and refreshes verbs; moving/open leaf sheds collision until safely shut
player enters castle-pad trigger -> scripts/castle-pad.js reads state.to/dir/room -> moves player one floor, resets velocity, then emits chime, bursts, flash and room toast (per-player 1.2s cooldown)
home-weather-controller -> syncDay/weatherAt -> place atmosphere and place.state.weather; dynamically spawns/removes rain, night ambience and fireflies and syncs lights/life effects
scripts/lib/data/home-day.js FROZEN_HOUR=10.5 and home-weather.js's single fair phase -> permanent daytime/fair atmosphere; solar/weather consumers still calculate dependent lights and effects
radio power/tune/next or face UI -> scripts/home-radio.js -> persistent radio state and positional self.audio; scripts/lib/radio-panel.js reads radio state for face labels
home-radio forecast -> place.state.weather.kind/nextAt -> report fade and music resume; current sole fair phase never satisfies clouding forecast condition
places/main/config.yaml terrain.generator -> scripts/den-terrain.js heightAt/materialAt -> engine terrain heightmap, materials and lake valley
place decoration layers and authored garden/portal rows -> valley-meadow/tree and home-garden generators -> seeded valley scatter, terrain-grounded garden, terrace and gateway approach
behaviorFamilies: scripts/gen/castle-keep.js + scripts/lib/data/castle.js - single composite five-floor keep, varied by central KEEP geometry; LOD >=4 uses a simplified distant drum
scripts/gen/castle-furnish.js + scripts/gen/castle-decor.js - castle furnishings and ornament families, varied by params.item/color/dimensions and authored instance seed

scripts/gen/home-architecture-*.js + home-architecture-kit.js - reusable den/wing foundations, floors, walls, joinery, glazing, doors, roofs, trim and chimney; retained architecture family alongside castle
scripts/gen/home-garden-*.js + home-garden-kit.js + hillside/window-garden data - terrace, path, birch, rock, planting, lantern and facade garden compositions, varied by site/species/seed
scripts/gen/valley-meadow.js, valley-tree.js, valley-outcrop.js + valley-mesh.js - procedural valley grass, forest scatter and authored chalk ledges, varied by generator params and seed
scripts/gen/den-furniture.js + den-furniture-mesh.js + den-blanket.js + templates/den-furniture.js - parameterized furnishing family retained for authored den furniture and reusable small pieces
scripts/player.js + scripts/humanoid-locomotion.js - player movement and humanoid gait pair, tuned by shared player data and body/attachment state
home-weather/day/lamplight + atmosphere templates/effects + scripts/lighting.js - shared solar ambience and practical-light family, presently driven by fixed fair daytime
migrationNotes: Castle dimensions live in scripts/lib/data/castle.js: centre (2,24,3), outer radius 7m, five 4.2m floors, and degree angles use x=cos(a), z=sin(a); keep geometry and placement edits aligned with this contract.
Castle waystone scene rows own their destination coordinates/yaw and room labels; castle-pad.js applies those exact world coordinates and has a module-level per-player 1.2s cooldown.
scripts/gen/castle-decor.js returns only a tiny 0.01m placeholder at LOD >=4; its authored indoor artwork/decor intentionally drops out at distance.
Day/night timing remains implemented as a 2-hour cycle, but FROZEN_HOUR=10.5 overrides it; weather data currently has one fair phase, and radio forecast logic still listens only for clouding.

The keep replaced the earlier timber den as the central building, but legacy home architecture/furnishing generators and garden, portal, device, interaction and ambience systems remain in the tree and in use; check scene references before retiring them.
HOME placement uses finished indoor floor Y=24 and prepared ground Y=23.55; keep the house/landscape coordinate contract intact when moving the keep, garden or gateway.
